nodes.summary: For a graph $H$ on the vertex set $\{0, \dots, k-1\}$ and a function $W$ of two real variables, the density $d(H, W)$ is the sum of the labelled densities $\tau(G, W)$ over all graphs $G$ on $\{0, \dots, k-1\}$ that are isomorphic to $H$.
nodes.title: Density of a graph in a graphon

nodes.summary: There are graphs $H_1, \dots, H_\ell$ and reals $d_1, \dots, d_\ell$ such that some graphon $W$ satisfies $d(H_i, W) = d_i$ for every $i$, but no finitely forcible graphon $W_0$ satisfies $d(H_i, W_0) = d_i$ for every $i$.
nodes.title: Lovász's finitely forcible optimum conjecture is false

nodes.summary: The proposition that for all graphs $H_1, \dots, H_\ell$ and reals $d_1, \dots, d_\ell$, if some graphon $W$ satisfies $d(H_i, W) = d_i$ for every $i$, then some finitely forcible graphon $W_0$ satisfies $d(H_i, W_0) = d_i$ for every $i$.
nodes.title: Lovász's finitely forcible optimum conjecture

nodes.summary: A function $W$ of two real variables is finitely forcible if there are finitely many graphs $H_1, \dots, H_\ell$ such that every graphon $W'$ with $d(H_i, W') = d(H_i, W)$ for all $i$ is weakly isomorphic to $W$.
nodes.title: Finitely forcible graphon

nodes.summary: A graphon is a function $W$ of two real variables that is jointly measurable (measurable as a function on $\mathbb{R}^2$), symmetric ($W(x, y) = W(y, x)$ for all real $x, y$) and takes values in $[0, 1]$ at every point of $\mathbb{R}^2$.
nodes.title: Graphon

nodes.title: Labelled density

nodes.summary: Two functions $W_1$ and $W_2$ of two real variables are weakly isomorphic if $d(H, W_1) = d(H, W_2)$ for every natural number $k$ and every graph $H$ on the vertex set $\{0, \dots, k-1\}$, where $d(H, W)$ is the density of $H$ in $W$.
nodes.title: Weak isomorphism

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
